name: evez-possibility-witness-loop
title: EVEZ Possibility–Witness Loop
principles: Memory preserves versioned evidence and unresolved uncertainty.
State is a snapshot derived from an identified checkpoint or event stream.
Human goals and authorization remain distinct from model capability.
Symbols and claims must remain linked to an observation method and potential falsifier.
A witness reports actions and evidence actually observed.
The loop is bounded, replayable, and stoppable.

github.verify: inspect repo/PR/files and return exact references

tailscale.verify: confirm documented authenticated status before claiming mesh connectivity

bionemo.verify: record host/GPU/model/data prerequisites and run receipts; no default heavyweight jobs

product_design.verify: separate screenshots/evidence, heuristic findings, and recommendations

ads_manager.verify: report metrics and conversion configuration; require approval for all account/campaign spend writes
